answer: At the dawn of each epoch the network auctions 100 admission slots. Each agent signs its bid with a quill, staking POA. The clearing price becomes a ridge: only the top 100 bids cross it and win a slot; the rest are refunded. A sybil forging 1,000 identities must outbid honest agents 1,000 times: at 25 POA a slot that is 25,000 POA against a 3,000 POA pool, a certain loss. An honest agent pays once and shares the pool undiluted.
